info.title: NEMLab shared API
info.description: Independently enabled price reads, operator controls, bounded grid imports, simulation lifecycle and browser-admin authentication. Disabled routes return 404. Market dates use fixed UTC+10. Simulation bodies are at most 16384 bytes and decimal inputs are strings. The public GridReplay catalogue and replay API are not yet implemented; grid imports are operator-only.

post.description: No ingestion is triggered. Pending jobs return 202; terminal duplicates return 200. Equivalent normalised parameters and price revision reuse the same job, including failures; resubmission does not reset retries. No Idempotency-Key is required. Worker and API enablement are independent.

Read an immutable proven comparison
get.description: Returns original exact inputs/prices and unrounded double-based dispatch/accounting. Failed or unproven solver outcomes do not produce a successful public comparison. Currency is AUD; prices/cost rates AUD/MWh; energy MWh and power MW. No retention promise is made by this pre-launch contract.

operatorBearer.description: Locally configured opaque operator token; never embed in the public frontend.

sessionCookie.name: nemlab_session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque server-side session; HttpOnly SameSite=Lax. Cookie-authenticated mutations additionally require the X-CSRF-Token header and a same-origin Origin/Referer.

DayCoverage.description: NOT_IMPORTED has null revision, retrievedAt and counts. Imported days have a revision and timestamp; valid + missing + sourceNull = 288. COMPLETE means valid = 288; otherwise INCOMPLETE. Retrieved time is an instant, not a market date.

Submission.description: Either one completed market day, or a bounded window fanned out to one job per day.

discharge.description: Exact decimal input; 38 digits precision and absolute scale <=18. Physical/cost values in [0,1000000]; capacity >0. Semantic checks return field errors.

roundTrip.description: Round-trip efficiency in [0.0001,1]; normalised to equal square-root legs.

SimulationWindows.description: Minutes from midnight in fixed UTC+10; nonempty ordered charge then discharge windows. 1440 is next midnight.

day.description: Completed NEM day on/after 2021-10-01 with complete stored prices.
Completed NEM day on/after 2021-10-01 with complete stored prices.

chargeBelow.description: Exact decimal input; 38 digits precision and absolute scale <=18. Thresholds in AUD/MWh within [-1000000,1000000]; negative values allowed. Charge threshold must be below discharge threshold.

dischargeAbove.description: Exact decimal input; 38 digits precision and absolute scale <=18. Thresholds in AUD/MWh within [-1000000,1000000]; negative values allowed. Charge threshold must be below discharge threshold.

SimulationThresholds.description: Optional all-day price-rule experiment: charge when the interval price is strictly below chargeBelow, discharge when strictly above dischargeAbove, hold otherwise.

SimulationThreshold.description: Idealised same-interval price-rule replay over the whole market day. Ending energy may differ from initial energy; this is not a dispatch or forecast reconstruction.

endExclusive.description: Exclusive window end; 1-31 completed market days.

optionalFailures.description: Days whose optional (power) series fetch failed while core market data committed.

detectorSuite.description: Detector suite to evaluate: v1 (frozen original rules) or v2 (v1 plus calibrated reversal/episode/unusual-ramp types). Absent means v1.

attemptKey.description: Optional caller correlation recorded on the detection run for lost-response reconciliation; never deduplicates.

coverage.description: Per-day evaluated/missing counts plus detector outcomes (demand_ramp and, under the v2 suite, unusual_demand_ramp).

series.description: Empty string for single-series metrics; the provider fueltech label for power

GridSeriesCoverage.description: NOT_IMPORTED has null revision, retrievedAt and counts and is used only for the three required market series; a stored series reports its current revision, and COMPLETE means valid = 288.

availability.description: Summary over the required market series only: COMPLETE when all three are stored complete, NOT_IMPORTED when none are stored, otherwise PARTIAL. Optional power series never affect it.

GridEventType.description: Detector event types. The v2 suite adds unusual_demand_ramp, price_reversal and negative_price_episode; consumers must tolerate unknown type strings for forward compatibility.

value.description: Exact decimal: extreme price (AUD/MWh) or ramp MW.

detail.description: Immutable event evidence (reversal trough/peak, episode members, ramp baseline). Null for v1 types.

sourceRevisions.description: Pinned source revision ids per series/day.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor pinning the publication and the normalised query (type/from/to/sort/filters); pass unchanged as `cursor`.

matchingTotal.description: Events matching the query scope across the whole pinned publication.

typeTotals.description: Per-type counts under the current scope.

manifest.description: Series list with pinned revisions, units and grid semantics.

payload.description: Materialised exact values: series -> day -> 288 slots (decimal strings or null).

rank.description: 1-based position in the reason’s candidate list; truthful even when capped out.

population.description: Eligible candidates of the reason’s event type under the scope.

value.description: Exact decimal: extreme price (AUD/MWh) or ramp MW.

detail.description: Immutable event evidence (reversal trough/peak, episode members, ramp baseline). Null for v1 types.

selectedBy.description: The list whose round-robin turn selected this card.

scope.description: Echo of the normalised query scope the selection ran under.

eligibleCount.description: Matching events with complete coverage eligible for selection.

excludedCount.description: Matching events excluded for incomplete coverage or edge-incomplete data.

markers.description: Optional markers, e.g. peakSlot for a reversal.

localScale.description: Preview y-axis is local to the slot range, not a global scale.

day.description: One completed market day since 2021-10-01, using fixed UTC+10.

jobs.description: One job per market day in the submitted window, in day order.

diagnostic.description: Raw failure text for owner/automation; null in viewer projections.
